name: The Missing Orders
summary: Dispatch Commander Ruag bristles when asked about the missing orders, insisting they were relayed. Ruag says the soldiers carrying them were ambushed by murlocs and only one lived, and sends you to speak with Bengor.

sections.title: Ruag's Account
sections.body: Ruag takes offence at the question and insists the orders were relayed. The soldiers sent with them were, Ruag says, ambushed and brutally beaten by murlocs, and only one lived, if that can be called living. The survivor can barely speak, cannot walk and is fed through a tube. To learn what became of the orders, Ruag says, speak with Bengor, who is around here somewhere, and adds a warning to mind what you poke your nose into, lest it get bitten off.

sections.title: Bengor's Halting Words
sections.body: When you find Bengor, only broken scraps of speech come out, and among them you catch the words swamp talker.

faq.q: Who sent the orders that went missing?
faq.answer: Dispatch Commander Ruag says the orders were relayed with the soldiers sent out, and grows defensive when asked what became of them.

faq.q: What happened to the soldiers carrying the orders?
faq.answer: According to Dispatch Commander Ruag, murlocs ambushed and brutally beat them, and only one lived.
Bengor is the one survivor of the ambush. He can barely speak, cannot walk and is fed through a tube.
Dispatch Commander Ruag says only that Bengor is around here somewhere.
